note: CI / tooling hardening (no runtime behaviour change). The vespera-bridge Gradle plugin's own test suite (NativePlatform detection + TestKit functional tests) now runs in the jni-e2e CI job on every host OS. Nine new trybuild compile-fail cases lock the user-facing vespera_macro diagnostics for #[route] misuse (non-pub / non-async / non-fn, non-2xx status, bad error_status, malformed headers), vespera! argument errors (unknown / duplicate key, invalid doc URLs, bad security scheme / server URL), schema! / schema_type! parameter and field-name errors, and malformed #[schema(...)] values. New differential cargo-fuzz target wire_header_parse checks the hand-rolled request wire-header parser against its serde_json twin, and a weekly (and on-demand) Fuzz workflow runs every fuzz target for a bounded time; a seeded randomized JUnit test does the same for the Java WireHeaderReader. Dependabot now proposes weekly grouped updates for cargo, the three Gradle builds, bun and GitHub Actions.
